description: List the TikTok ADVERTISER accounts this profile can act on — id, name, currency, timezone and status. Every other TikTok Ads tool needs an advertiserId, and this is where it comes from: call this first and let the USER pick when there is more than one. Read-only, free, spends nothing. Needs TikTok ADS connected (Settings > Connectors > TikTok Ads). When nothing is shared and the user's TikTok login has no ad account at all, the reply says so: offer to create one with create_tiktok_ads_account.
name: list_tiktok_ads_accounts
title: List TikTok advertiser accounts
